scope: Ki Blast Super catalog — current-category omissions

records.name: Mighty Explosive Wave
records.effect: Short-range explosive Ki Super that detonates around the user; can be held to consume additional Ki and prolong the explosion.

records.name: Power Blitz
records.effect: Fires a large Ki projectile; holding the input allows additional shots while consuming more Ki.

records.name: Energy Minefield
records.effect: Places a field of delayed Ki mines that detonate when opponents approach.

records.name: Blaster Shell
records.effect: Launches a tracking explosive Ki projectile; additional input can alter the follow-up sequence.

records.name: Galick Beam Cannon
records.effect: Fast linear Ki beam with an optional follow-up that extends the attack.

records.name: Focus Flash
records.effect: Charges a concentrated Ki shot; follow-up input releases a stronger focused blast.
